description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_서울시 중랑구 우편번호별 우체국택배 물량 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 이 데이터는 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부에서 제공한 서울시 중랑구 지역의 우편번호별 월간 우체국택배 물량을 기록한 통계 자료로, 각 우편번호 구역별로 1월부터 12월까지의 월별 물량. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 우편번호, 중랑구, 월별 물량, 우체국택배, 택배 수요. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
